Your AI coding setup is missing these 5 MCPs 👀

MCPs (Model Context Protocol) help AI tools connect to external tools, documentation, and services, so they can do more than just generate code.

Here are 5 worth exploring for your next build:

✦ Context7 — Gives your AI coding assistant access to up-to-date documentation.

✦ Magic UI — Helps AI tools discover and use beautiful, animated UI components.

✦ Figma MCP — Connects your Figma designs to AI coding tools for smoother design-to-code workflows.

✦ Supabase MCP — Lets AI assistants interact with your database and backend services.

✦ Playwright MCP — Enables AI agents to interact with websites, automate browser tasks, and test your builds.
